fact: On 4 February 2025 the Minister directed the new UCSAF board to oversee building 758 rural communication towers, and the Permanent Secretary said UCSAF had reached 1,582 wards and 4,396 villages with 1,725 towers.
title: Waziri Silaa Aiagiza Bodi ya UCSAF Kusimamia Ujenzi wa Minara 758 ya Mawasiliano Vijijini ili Kuchochea Uchumi wa Kidijitali
